name: Fairmont Pittsburgh
positioning: Fairmont hotel in downtown Pittsburgh, in the city's business, theater and retail hub
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown base within walking distance of Market Square
Families wanting a suite with a living room and sofa bed

facts.text: The hotel is at the heart of Pittsburgh's business, theater and retail hub, within walking distance of Market Square.
Guest rooms have views of landmarks such as Mt. Washington or PNC Park.
Deluxe Ballpark View rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of PNC Park, a soaking tub and a separate walk-in shower.
The Signature One Bedroom Suite is a corner suite described as ideal for families, with a living room with sofa bed, a dining nook and two full bathrooms.
The hotel's restaurant is fl.2, serving modern American food.
There is an on-site Starbucks at the hotel.
The gym has floor-to-ceiling windows with downtown views.
Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2017 and 2026.

highlights.text: The Deluxe Mt. rooms are on floors 20-23 and have floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views of Mt. Washington over the city skyline.
The Presidential Suite has a design inspired by Pittsburgh's natural elements, a marble entry foyer and hard wood floors.
The Harris One Bedroom Suite is at the end of the 20th guest floor and has a kitchenette and a full-sized refrigerator.
The hotel has a Les Clefs d'Or concierge.
The spa has a dry cedar sauna and an eucalyptus steam room.

considerations.text: Valet parking and an on-site self-parking garage are available, both for an additional fee.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack traditional resort amenities.
Pets of all sizes are welcome for a nightly fee of $60, and must stay on a leash and not be left unattended in guest rooms.
